title: Croatian Dough Pancakes
description: A traditional Croatian breakfast dish made with a simple dough and topped with various ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, and yeast.
Add milk, eggs, and melted butter. Mix until smooth.
Gradually add the dough and mix until a sticky ball forms.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
